verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an API reference section, including the HTTP API, a "Complete Pixel API reference", Transformations, Audit Logs, and Event Audit APIs. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable try-it examples, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. The Event Playground app is a separate sample-event tool, not an API reference. missing for 10: interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable code examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
